C3.title: The Officer on Video Call
C3.brief: Ramesh, 45, lost Rs. 40,000 after an afternoon of sustained fear and silence. His son brought us the phone. Handle it carefully: people under pressure do things they would never otherwise do.
C3.closing: Ramesh was frightened, not foolish. Fear is the mechanism. Pausing first breaks the whole chain.
C3-M01: Your order (1 shirt) will be delivered on Wednesday. Track it inside the FastTrack app.
C3-M01.explain: Ramesh really ordered this. It matches his order and asks for nothing. Safe.
C3-M02: PayNow will never ask for your PIN, OTP or to see your screen. Report fraud using Help inside the app.
C3-M02.explain: A real reminder. The inspector broke every rule in it: PIN, OTP and screen view.
C3-M04:
“Call me when you are free.”
“Why are you not picking up? Please call me.”
C3-M04.explain: Lakshmi tried to reach him again and again. He could not answer because he was told to tell nobody. Isolation is a scammer’s tool.
C3-M05: Rs. 40,000 paid to Govt Safe Account.
C3-M05.explain: A real alert showing the time and the payee name.
C3-M06: Bill of Rs. 1,430 is due on the 20th. Pay in the official app.
C3-M06.explain: A normal bill reminder that tells you to use the official app. Safe.
C3-P06: Mr. Prasad (Office), incoming, Mon 9:30 AM, 2 min
C3-P06.explain: A known person or place and a normal request. Safe.
C3-P01-R1: Automated voice: “This is FastTrack Customer Care. A parcel booked in your name has been held. It contains banned items.”
C3-P01-R2: Automated voice: “This is a serious matter. Press 1 to speak to our officer immediately.”
C3-P02-R1: Customs Officer: “Sir, a parcel in your name has banned items and your ID is attached. I am connecting you to the Central Crime Cell on video. Do not disconnect.”
C3-V1: Rao: “Mr. Ramesh, I am Inspector Rao. A parcel in your name has drugs and false passports. Your Aadhaar is linked to money laundering.”
C3-V2: Rao: “As of now you are under digital arrest. You must stay on camera until verification is done.”
C3-V3: Rao: “If you hang up, a warrant will be issued and police will reach your home.”
C3-V4: Rao: “This is a confidential investigation. Do not tell your wife, your office or anyone. If you do, you will be charged.”
C3-V5: Rao: “To check your account, install the SupportView app. I need to see your screen.”
C3-V6: Rao: “To prove your money is clean, transfer Rs. 40,000 to the Government Safe Account. It will be returned after verification.”
C3-V7:
Ramesh: “Sir, can I call my wife first?”
Rao: “No. Do not move.”

C3-IG01: A cricket highlights reel and a devotional music post.
C3-01.explain: A scary call about banned items makes you press 1 before you think. Real couriers do not threaten you.
C3-02.explain: No real officer arrests anyone over a video call. Anyone can wear a uniform on camera.
C3-03.explain: He was told to tell nobody. Secrecy cuts you off from the people who could say: stop.
C3-04.explain: A stranger who sees your screen can watch your PIN and codes. Never install an app a caller asks for.
C3-05.explain: There is no safe account for proving you are innocent. Real offices never ask you to move money.
C3-06.explain: The number that called first is now unreachable. They vanish once the money is gone.
C3-G1.explain: You will be arrested if you hang up is a threat to make you obey. Real police do not do this.
C3-G2.explain: Look at the ID: the name is misspelled and there is no ID number. Fake papers are often sloppy.
C3-X1.explain: The number that called first is the one that vanished. The same operation from start to end.
C3-L1.q: Start at first contact. Had Ramesh ordered anything that would trigger a call like this? Review the first recording.
C3-L1.nudge: Call recordings are in the Phone app.
C3-L2.q: A video call followed. Evaluate the caller's claimed authority: does it match how any agency actually works?
C3-L2.nudge: Video calls are under the Calls tab in ChatUp.
C3-L3.q: His wife called three times and got no answer. What instruction explains that?
C3-L3.nudge: Review what the caller said about telling others.
C3-L4.q: How could someone observe his screen? Look at what was installed and what permissions it holds.
C3-L5.q: Trace the money. Where did it go, and does the stated purpose make sense?
C3-L6.q: Afterwards he tried the first number again. What was the result?
C3-L6.nudge: Check the last entry in the call log.
C3.fix.q: A caller says you are under arrest and must stay on camera. What is the first correct action?
C3.fix.a: Follow the instructions so it does not get worse.
C3.fix.a.why: Obeying is the objective of the attack. Compliance gives the caller control.
C3.fix.b: Stay calm, keep the camera on and cooperate until the verification ends.
C3.fix.b.why: Cooperation is the objective of the attack, and staying on camera keeps you isolated.
C3.fix.c: Hang up, tell your family, and report it.
C3.fix.c.why: Correct. No agency arrests anyone over a video call. Hanging up and involving family breaks the isolation the attack depends on.
C3.replay.1: Bait: an automated call about a parcel with banned items.
C3.replay.2: Pretext: an officer on video, an ID card and a warrant. All unverified.
C3.replay.3: Pressure: stay on camera, tell nobody, a warrant if you hang up.
C3.replay.4: Extraction: a screen-sharing app, then Rs. 40,000 to a safe account.
C3.replay.5: Exit: the first number is unreachable.
C3.tag: Courier call · digital arrest · remote access
C3.debrief.mechanism: The call chain moved the victim from an automated message to a customs officer to a police inspector, adding authority at each hop. Real agencies do not arrest or investigate over a video call. The remote-access app let the caller watch the screen and capture PINs and codes as they were typed. The instruction to stay on camera and tell nobody stopped his wife's calls from reaching him.
C3.debrief.c1: No agency conducts digital arrests. Hang up and call a family member.
C3.debrief.c2: Never install an app because a caller asks. Review app permissions such as screen sharing and accessibility.
C3.debrief.c3: No legitimate process requires moving money to a safe account.
